meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意文本自动生成无脸解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把文章或笔记快速变成解说视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into a faceless explainer video automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly turn articles or notes into explainer videos

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你的文章、笔记或主题变成一段“无脸”解说视频——画面全是自动生成的文字、图表和抽象图形，不需要任何真实素材。
howto.when: 当你给 Claude 一段文字（文章、笔记、主题等），并明确要求制作解说视频时触发。

say.text: 把这篇关于复利的文章做成解说视频。
say.note: Claude 会启动流程，生成视频。

say.text: 用这段笔记做一个“如何做”的解说视频。
say.note: Claude 会按步骤制作教程视频。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude turns your article, notes, or topic into a faceless explainer video—visuals are auto-generated typography, diagrams, and abstract graphics, no real footage needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you give Claude a text (article, notes, topic) and explicitly ask to make an explainer video.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into an explainer video.
say_en.note: Claude starts the process and generates the video.

say_en.text: Make a how-to explainer video from these notes.
say_en.note: Claude creates a step-by-step tutorial video.
